newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Gecamines HQ closes as rebels advance.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Gecamines HQ closes as rebels advance.

text.p: Zaire's Gecamines mining company closed its headquarters, situated in the Copperbelt city of Lubumbashi, on Monday as rebels forces of Laurent Kabila took the town of Kipushi just 30 km away, eyewitnesses said.
The Gecamines offices were deserted apart from two security guards.
"The directors are all at home. The company is not working because of news that rebels have reached Kipushi," one of the security guards told Reuters.
Officials at Sizarail, a Belgian-South African consortium that runs the railway in the area, said its offices were also closed until further notice.
Sizarail is responsible for transporting copper and cobalt from mines in Zaire's mineral-rich Shaba province. It was not immediately clear what the status was of upcountry mines.
